modelIdentity.explanation: No exact model identifier was supplied to the reviewer. The model was inherited without a specified identifier; available model names are not evidence of the model used.

generationParameterSemantics: model=unknown records unavailable identity; reasoningEffort=default records no explicit override and does not identify a resolved effort; forkTurns=none records the coordinator-stated original isolated agent dispatch configuration. This B032w task was assigned to the existing reviewer agent.
reviewIsolationMeaning: The B032w first-pass decision used only its own supplied current prompt, criteria, schema, campaign and input. Other B032w round output and prior decisions for this goal were not inspected. The already-returned record was persisted without content changes after both first passes completed.

observedTiming.semantics: The manifest's required startedAt and completedAt fields store observed run clock markers: a clock read while B032w instructions were being reviewed and the clock read after the complete record was assembled and schema-validated. They are not inferred model start or finish times and do not establish inference duration.

outputSerialization: Exactly the already-returned record as one UTF-8 JSON line with a final newline; no review-content changes.
unknownMetricsExplanation: Exact inference duration, token usage, and cost were not provided by the execution environment and have not been estimated.
